premise: Drone wants the perfect photo of the lander on its pad; Robo-dog keeps sitting up in it and the buggy spins up a cloud of dust — the messy photo is the one everyone keeps.
inspiration: Aesop's 'The Miller, His Son and the Donkey' (pleasing everyone), turned: trying to get it just right makes the best picture by accident.
lesson: The best memories are rarely the tidy ones.

en-US.title: Say Moon Cheese
en-US.text: {drone:float loop 0.3} {drone:enter} Drone wanted one perfect photo: the {lander:enter} lander, {lander:go to pad} standing on the landing pad, neat and gold. {drone:live hold} It zoomed in its lens. Focus… focus… {robodog:enter} {robodog:go to lander} Robo-dog trotted into the picture and {robodog:live} sat up, paws in the air. {robodog:face happy} Not you! said Drone. {robodog:face sad} Robo-dog wandered off. Focus… focus… {buggy:enter} {buggy:go to lander} Then the buggy rolled up and {canvas:dust 5s} {buggy:live} spun its wheels. {sfx:whirr} Wheee! Grey dust everywhere. {lander:live} The lander opened its hatch to see what all the fuss was about. [sighs] Drone gave up and — {sfx:flash} {drone:live resume} FLASH! — took the photo anyway. There it was: a dog doing a trick, a buggy in a cloud, a lander peeking out. {robodog:face surprised} The worst photo ever taken on the Moon. {all:face happy} {all:hop} Everyone's favourite.

es-ES.title: Di patata lunar
es-ES.text: {drone:float loop 0.3} {drone:enter} Dron quería una foto perfecta: el {lander:enter} módulo lunar {lander:go to pad} en la plataforma de aterrizaje, reluciente y dorado. {drone:live hold} Acercó el zoom. Enfocar… enfocar… {robodog:enter} {robodog:go to lander} Perro robot se metió en la foto y {robodog:live} se sentó con las patas en el aire. {robodog:face happy} ¡Tú no! dijo Dron. {robodog:face sad} Perro robot se fue. Enfocar… enfocar… {buggy:enter} {buggy:go to lander} Entonces llegó el buggy y {canvas:dust 5s} {buggy:live} hizo girar las ruedas. {sfx:whirr} ¡Yuuuju! Polvo gris por todas partes. {lander:live} El módulo abrió la escotilla para ver a qué venía tanto jaleo. [sighs] Dron se rindió y — {sfx:flash} {drone:live resume} ¡FLASH! — hizo la foto de todas formas. Y ahí estaba: un perro haciendo una gracia, un buggy dentro de una nube, un módulo asomándose. {robodog:face surprised} La peor foto jamás hecha en la Luna. {all:face happy} {all:hop} La favorita de todos.

whirr.prompt: small rubber wheels spinning fast in loose sand, a whirring grind, playful

flash.prompt: a camera shutter click with a soft flash whine, quick and clean
